questions.stem: INTERNATIONAL YOGA DAY is celebrated annually on:

options.option_text: 21 JUNE — declared by UN in 2014 (177 co-sponsors); proposed by PM MODI at 69th UN General Assembly; summer solstice

questions.explanation: INTERNATIONAL DAY OF YOGA (IDY) — 21 JUNE annually; global celebration of yoga's physical + mental + spiritual benefits. PROPOSED by PM NARENDRA MODI at his maiden speech to 69TH UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY in NEW YORK on 27 September 2014: 'Yoga is an invaluable gift of India's ancient tradition... let us work towards adopting an International Yoga Day.' UN GA ADOPTED the resolution A/RES/69/131 on 11 December 2014 with a RECORD 177 CO-SPONSORS (most for any UNGA resolution). FIRST IDY on 21 JUNE 2015 — Rajpath Delhi, PM Modi led 35,985 people in world's largest yoga demonstration (Guinness); 84 nationalities participated; 21 yoga asanas demonstrated. WHY 21 JUNE: (a) SUMMER SOLSTICE in Northern Hemisphere — LONGEST DAY of year; transition from sun's uttarayana (northward) to dakshinayana; spiritually significant day in Hindu tradition; first full-moon after solstice is Guru Purnima linked to Shiva as Adiguru of yoga; (b) widely acceptable for global participation. SUBSEQUENT IDY HIGHLIGHTS: (2016) Chandigarh, 30,000; (2017) Lucknow; (2018) Dehradun; (2019) Ranchi; (2020) digital due to COVID; (2021-22) Mysuru Palace + digital; (2023) NEW YORK UN HQ — PM Modi led global yoga session at UN lawns during his state visit; Guinness for 'most nationalities doing yoga chain' (135). (2024) Srinagar — PM led on banks of Dal Lake; 2025 + 2026 in various cities. YOGA origin: ~5000 years in Indian Vedic tradition; systematised by SAGE PATANJALI (~200 BCE-200 CE) in YOGA SUTRAS — 196 aphorisms in 4 chapters defining ASHTANGA (8 limbs of yoga): YAMA, NIYAMA, ASANA, PRANAYAMA, PRATYAHARA, DHARANA, DHYANA, SAMADHI. 8 LIMBS of Patanjali. PATHS: Hatha (physical), Raja (meditation), Karma (action), Bhakti (devotion), Jnana (knowledge), Kundalini, Tantra. POPULAR STYLES: Ashtanga Vinyasa (K. Pattabhi Jois), Iyengar (B.K.S. Iyengar), Bikram (Bikram Choudhury), Kundalini (Yogi Bhajan), Sivananda (Swami Sivananda), Art of Living (Sri Sri Ravi Shankar), Isha (Sadhguru), Vipassana (Goenka tradition). WHO-accepted non-communicable disease prevention modality; India's Ministry of AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) est 2014 promotes it. YOGA inscribed on UNESCO's REPRESENTATIVE LIST OF INTANGIBLE CULTURAL HERITAGE OF HUMANITY (2016). CONCERNS: COMMERCIALISATION (Lululemon yoga pants — $150+), 'wellness industry' commodification; cultural appropriation debates in West. India's FEM (Fit India Movement, 2019) integrates yoga.

questions.stem: WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY is celebrated on:

options.option_text: 5 JUNE — declared by UN in 1972 following Stockholm Conference; India hosted global WED in 2018 (theme Beat Plastic Pollution)

questions.explanation: WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY (WED) — 5 JUNE annually; world's premier environmental awareness day. ESTABLISHED: UN General Assembly 1972 Resolution 2994 — marked 50th anniversary + opening day of STOCKHOLM CONFERENCE (UN Conference on the Human Environment, 5-16 June 1972) — FIRST UN environment conference; led to creation of UNEP (UN Environment Programme, HQ Nairobi, 1972). FIRST OBSERVED 1974. ANNUAL THEME + HOST COUNTRY: each year a different country hosts, with a specific theme. (1) 2018 — INDIA hosted WED (Delhi); theme 'BEAT PLASTIC POLLUTION'; PM Modi announced phase-out of single-use plastics (commitment delivered 1 July 2022 — banned 19 SUP items). (2) 2023 — Côte d'Ivoire; Beat Plastic Pollution (again, 5-year progress). (3) 2024 — Saudi Arabia; 'Land Restoration, Desertification + Drought Resilience'. (4) 2025 — South Korea; 'Beat Plastic Pollution'. UNEP's major environmental campaigns: Mobilise for Our Planet, Generation Restoration, Act Now, World Environment Situation Room. OTHER MAJOR ENV-RELATED DAYS: (1) WORLD WETLANDS DAY — 2 Feb (Ramsar 1971). (2) WORLD WATER DAY — 22 Mar (UN 1992). (3) EARTH HOUR — last Sat Mar; lights off 8:30-9:30 pm (WWF 2007 Sydney originated). (4) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF FORESTS — 21 Mar. (5) WORLD METEOROLOGICAL DAY — 23 Mar (WMO 1961). (6) EARTH DAY — 22 Apr (1970 US; now international; Paris Agreement signed on Earth Day 2016). (7) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY — 22 May. (8) WORLD OCEAN DAY — 8 Jun. (9) WORLD DAY TO COMBAT DESERTIFICATION + DROUGHT — 17 Jun. (10) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR PRESERVATION OF OZONE LAYER — 16 Sep (Montreal Protocol 1987). (11) WORLD RHINO DAY — 22 Sep. (12) WORLD TOURISM DAY — 27 Sep. (13) WORLD ANIMAL DAY — 4 Oct. (14) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF CLIMATE ACTION — 24 Oct. (15) INTERNATIONAL MOUNTAIN DAY — 11 Dec. (16) WORLD SOIL DAY — 5 Dec. (17) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF DISASTER REDUCTION — 13 Oct. CONVENTIONS: CBD (Biodiversity), CITES (Trade in Endangered Species), CMS (Migratory Species), UNFCCC (climate), UNCCD (desertification), Ramsar (wetlands), Basel (hazardous waste), Rotterdam (chemicals), Stockholm (POPs), Minamata (mercury 2013), Vienna-Montreal (ozone), Kigali (HFCs 2016). India is party to all major env conventions.

questions.stem: NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY is celebrated on 28 FEBRUARY in honour of:

options.option_text: DISCOVERY OF RAMAN EFFECT on 28 Feb 1928 by C.V. RAMAN; India observes since 1986 with theme-based events

questions.explanation: NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY (NSD) — 28 FEBRUARY annually in India. OBSERVED since 1987. COMMEMORATES DISCOVERY of RAMAN EFFECT by SIR C.V. RAMAN on 28 February 1928 — for which he was awarded NOBEL PRIZE IN PHYSICS in 1930 (first Asian Nobel in any science). RAMAN EFFECT: inelastic scattering of light — monochromatic light passing through transparent medium has small portion scattered at different wavelengths due to molecular vibrations/rotations. Basis of RAMAN SPECTROSCOPY — widely used in chemistry, material science, pharmaceutical identification, forensics, gem-testing (detecting synthetic diamonds). DISCOVERY made at Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (IACS), Calcutta, using simple equipment (monochromatic mercury-arc lamp + prism) in collaboration with K.S. Krishnan. Landenburg, Soviet scientists had predicted + observed earlier but Raman published coherently + got credit. PRIZE: ₹2,00,000 (1930) + diploma. THEMES for NSD (select years): 2015 'Science for Nation Building', 2018 'Science + Tech for a Sustainable Future', 2023 'Global Science for Global Wellbeing' (G20 linkage), 2024 'Indigenous Technologies for Viksit Bharat', 2025 'Science + Innovation for All'. NODAL AGENCY: Department of Science + Technology (DST) + NCSTC (National Council for Science + Technology Communication). Other INDIAN SCIENCE DAYS: (1) NATIONAL TECHNOLOGY DAY — 11 MAY (Pokhran-II anniversary 1998, Vajpayee; also test of Agni-II + first indigenous aircraft Hansa-3). (2) INTERNATIONAL YEAR OF MILLETS — 2023 (India-proposed; G20). (3) INTERNATIONAL YEAR OF ASTRONOMY — 2009 (Galileo 400 yrs). INDIAN SCIENCE ICONS: (1) C.V. RAMAN — Nobel 1930 Physics; Raman Effect. (2) S. CHANDRASEKHAR — Nobel 1983 Physics (Indian-American); Chandrasekhar limit for white dwarfs. (3) HAR GOBIND KHORANA — Nobel 1968 Medicine (Indian-American); genetic code. (4) VENKATRAMAN RAMAKRISHNAN — Nobel 2009 Chemistry (US-Indian); ribosome structure. (5) J.C. BOSE — pioneer of wireless + plant physiology. (6) SATYENDRA NATH BOSE — Bose-Einstein statistics + condensate; bosons named after him. (7) MEGHNAD SAHA — Saha ionisation equation (astrophysics). (8) HOMI BHABHA — atomic energy father. (9) VIKRAM SARABHAI — space programme father. (10) M.S. SWAMINATHAN — Green Revolution. (11) A.P.J. ABDUL KALAM — missile man + 11th President; Bharat Ratna 1997. (12) CNR RAO — solid state chemistry; Bharat Ratna 2014. (13) BHARAT RATNA scientists — CV Raman, APJ Kalam, CNR Rao, MS Swaminathan (2024 posthumous). (14) G.N. RAMACHANDRAN — Ramachandran plot (protein structure). (15) YELLAPRAGADA SUBBAROW — folic acid, tetracycline.

questions.stem: Match these NATIONAL INDIAN DAYS: (1) TEACHERS' DAY; (2) CHILDREN'S DAY; (3) ENGINEERS' DAY; (4) DOCTORS' DAY.

options.option_text: 5 SEP (Radhakrishnan b.); 14 NOV (Nehru b.); 15 SEP (Visvesvaraya b.); 1 JUL (B.C. Roy b.)

questions.explanation: INDIAN NATIONAL DAYS in honour of great Indians: (1) TEACHERS' DAY — 5 SEPTEMBER. Birthday of Dr. SARVEPALLI RADHAKRISHNAN (1888-1975), great philosopher + 2nd PRESIDENT of India (1962-67). When some students asked to celebrate his birthday in 1962, he suggested it be dedicated to teachers instead. UNIVERSAL TEACHERS' DAY (UNESCO) = 5 Oct. (2) CHILDREN'S DAY (Bal Diwas) — 14 NOVEMBER. Birthday of PANDIT JAWAHARLAL NEHRU (1889-1964), India's first PM. 'CHACHA NEHRU' loved children; his birthday declared Bal Diwas after his death 1964 (previously 20 Nov per UN). UNIVERSAL CHILDREN'S DAY = 20 Nov (UN). (3) ENGINEERS' DAY — 15 SEPTEMBER. Birthday of SIR M. VISVESVARAYA (MOKSHAGUNDAM VISVESVARAYA, 1861-1962), Bharat Ratna 1955; legendary civil engineer; Diwan of Mysore (1912-18); designed KRISHNA RAJA SAGAR DAM (Cauvery, Mandya), Hyderabad flood control, automatic weir floodgates for Khadakwasla Dam. Lived 101 years. (4) DOCTORS' DAY (National Doctors' Day) — 1 JULY. Birth + death anniversary of Dr. BIDHAN CHANDRA ROY (1882-1962), Bharat Ratna 1961; great physician + 2nd CM of WB (1948-62); founded Jadavpur TB Hospital + Chittaranjan Cancer Hospital. Observed since 1991. Note: WORLD DOCTORS' DAY = 30 Mar (USA). OTHER KEY INDIAN DAYS: (5) FARMERS' DAY (Kisan Diwas) — 23 DEC. Birthday of CHAUDHARY CHARAN SINGH (1902-87), 5th PM. (6) FAMILY DAY (INTL) — 15 May. (7) BHARAT RATNA B.R. AMBEDKAR Jayanti — 14 APRIL. (8) NETAJI SUBHAS CHANDRA BOSE Jayanti / PARAKRAM DIWAS — 23 JAN (since 2021). (9) TILAK Jayanti — 23 JUL. (10) GANDHI JAYANTI / INTL NON-VIOLENCE DAY — 2 OCT (UN 2007). Martyrs' Day (Shaheed Diwas) = 30 Jan (Gandhi's death). (11) SUBHAS CHANDRA BOSE Death Anniversary / PARAKRAM — 18 Aug. (12) INDIRA GANDHI's Death — 31 Oct (National Unity Day / Rashtriya Ekta Diwas since 2014 on SARDAR PATEL's birthday 31 Oct; Indira's death same day coincidence). (13) RAJIV GANDHI — Sadbhavana Diwas 20 Aug (birthday); death 21 May 1991 (Anti-Terrorism Day). (14) Dr. A.P.J. ABDUL KALAM — Birthday 15 OCT. (15) KARGIL VIJAY DIWAS — 26 JUL. (16) NATIONAL VOTERS' DAY — 25 JAN. (17) INDIAN ARMY Day — 15 JAN. (18) AIR FORCE Day — 8 OCT. (19) NAVY Day — 4 DEC. (20) CDS day — 1 JAN (since 2020). (21) RTI Day — 12 Oct. (22) LAW Day / CONSTITUTION Day — 26 NOV (Constitution adoption 1949). (23) ARMED FORCES FLAG DAY — 7 DEC. (24) NATIONAL SPORTS DAY — 29 AUG (hockey wizard Dhyan Chand's birthday).

questions.stem: WORLD WOMEN'S DAY is observed globally on:

options.option_text: 8 MARCH — annual UN-recognised day; theme-based; 2024 theme 'Invest in Women'; INDIAN women's day 13 FEB (Sarojini Naidu's birthday)

questions.explanation: INTERNATIONAL WOMEN'S DAY (IWD) — 8 MARCH annually. UN-recognised global day celebrating women's social, economic, cultural, political achievements + advocating gender equality. HISTORY: (1) 1908 — first Women's Day in USA (Feb 28, Socialist Party of America). (2) 1910 — International Conference of Working Women in Copenhagen agreed on an annual Women's Day (proposed by Clara Zetkin, German socialist). (3) 1911 — first IWD in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Denmark (19 March). (4) 1917 — Russian women's protest on 8 March (Gregorian; 23 Feb Julian) contributed to February Revolution + Tsar's abdication; Lenin declared 8 March official Women's Day. (5) 1975 — UN International Women's Year; 1977 — UN adopted 8 March as IWD. THEMES (annual): 2024 'Invest in Women: Accelerate Progress'; 2023 'DigitALL'; 2022 'Gender equality today for a sustainable tomorrow'. COLOUR: PURPLE (justice + dignity; UK women's suffrage colours: purple + green + white). INDIAN WOMEN'S DAY — 13 FEBRUARY (different from global 8 Mar). Birthday of SAROJINI NAIDU (1879-1949), 'Nightingale of India'. Other Women-related days: (1) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF THE GIRL CHILD — 11 OCT (UN 2011). (2) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR ELIMINATION OF VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN — 25 NOV. (3) NATIONAL GIRL CHILD DAY India — 24 JAN. (4) WORLD POPULATION DAY — 11 JUL. (5) BREAST CANCER AWARENESS MONTH — OCT. MILESTONE WOMEN'S RIGHTS LAWS in INDIA: (a) Hindu Marriage Act 1955 + Special Marriage Act 1954; (b) Dowry Prohibition Act 1961; (c) Equal Remuneration Act 1976; (d) Maternity Benefit Act 1961 (amended 2017 — 26 weeks leave); (e) Domestic Violence Act 2005; (f) Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013 (POSH, post-Nirbhaya); (g) Triple Talaq criminalised 2019; (h) IPC Sec 498A + 354 + 375 (marital rape exception controversial, 2024 SC hearing). EDUCATION + PROGRAMMES: BETI BACHAO BETI PADHAO (2015, Panipat), SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI YOJANA (girl savings), MATRU VANDANA YOJANA (maternity benefit ₹5000 first child), STAND-UP INDIA (SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs), Mahila E-Haat, Working Women Hostel, Swadhar Greh, One Stop Centre (Sakhi), 181 Women Helpline, NARI DO (POSHAN), NIPUN Bharat. WOMEN FIRSTS India (partial list): PM Indira Gandhi (1966); President Pratibha Patil (2007-12); Draupadi Murmu (2022-); CJ Fathima Beevi (SC judge 1989); CM Sucheta Kripalani (UP 1963); IAS Anna Rajam Malhotra (1951); Nobel - MOTHER TERESA (Peace 1979); BHARAT RATNA - Indira Gandhi (1971), M.S. Subbulakshmi (1998), Lata Mangeshkar (2001), Aruna Asaf Ali (posthumous 1997). Miss World Reita Faria (1966); Miss Universe Sushmita Sen (1994), Lara Dutta (2000), Harnaaz Sandhu (2021). Sania Mirza + Saina Nehwal + PV Sindhu + Mary Kom sports.

questions.stem: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS (National Unity Day) — 31 OCTOBER, commemorates:

options.option_text: BIRTH ANNIVERSARY of SARDAR VALLABHBHAI PATEL (1875-1950) — 'Iron Man of India'; unified ~565 princely states; first HOME MINISTER + DY PM

questions.explanation: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS (National Unity Day) — 31 OCTOBER — BIRTH ANNIVERSARY of SARDAR VALLABHBHAI PATEL (31 Oct 1875 – 15 Dec 1950). Instituted 2014 by PM MODI. SARDAR PATEL — 'IRON MAN OF INDIA' / 'BISMARCK OF INDIA'. Born Nadiad, Gujarat. Barrister from Middle Temple London (1913); cleared Bar exam with distinction. Political career via Ahmedabad Municipality + Kheda Satyagraha (1918) + Bardoli Satyagraha (1928, earned 'Sardar' title from Gandhi). Founding member of Congress. CONTRIBUTIONS: (1) Unified ~565 PRINCELY STATES into Indian Union 1947-1949 — arguably ONE OF THE greatest political achievements of the 20th century. Employed combination of diplomacy, persuasion, threat, military (Junagadh 1947, Hyderabad Police Action/Operation Polo 1948; Kashmir negotiated accession Oct 1947 + war). Only J&K remained problematic; Goa taken 1961 by Nehru. SECRETARY V.P. MENON critical aide. (2) Became INDIA's FIRST DEPUTY PM + HOME MINISTER (1947-50). (3) Founded INDIAN ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICE (IAS) + INDIAN POLICE SERVICE (IPS) — 'Steel Frame' of India; spoke for permanent + strong civil services in Constituent Assembly. (4) Chaired 3 CA committees — Fundamental Rights, Minorities, Provincial Constitution. (5) Organized reconstruction of SOMNATH TEMPLE (Gujarat) — destroyed by Mahmud of Ghazni + others; completed 1951 posthumous. (6) Organised relief + rehabilitation for ~10 million Partition refugees. DIED 15 Dec 1950. Bharat Ratna (posthumous) 1991. STATUE OF UNITY — 182m TALL (world's TALLEST statue since 2018) at Kevadia, Narmada Gujarat; inaugurated 31 Oct 2018 by PM Modi on Patel's 143rd birth anniv; designed by RAM V. SUTAR; cost ₹2,989 crore. 'RUN FOR UNITY' pledge + events + state functions conducted on 31 OCT every year at various levels. IRONY: 31 Oct is ALSO day of INDIRA GANDHI's ASSASSINATION (31 Oct 1984, by her Sikh bodyguards Beant Singh + Satwant Singh, post-Operation Blue Star). Both commemorated separately. OTHER UNITY-related days: (1) NATIONAL INTEGRATION DAY (Qaumi Ekta Diwas) — 19 Nov (Indira Gandhi's birth anniversary). Rashtriya Ekta Diwas 2014 replaced emphasis on 19 Nov. (2) ARMED FORCES FLAG DAY — 7 DEC (collections for armed forces welfare). (3) COMMUNAL HARMONY WEEK — 19-25 Nov. COMPLEMENTARY LEADERS days: (a) Ambedkar Jayanti (14 Apr — SAMVIDHAN DIWAS / Constitution Day is 26 Nov); (b) Shastri Jayanti (2 Oct); (c) Bose Jayanti/Parakram Diwas (23 Jan); (d) Indira Gandhi (19 Nov Birthday + 31 Oct death); (e) Rajiv Gandhi Sadbhavana (20 Aug) + Anti-Terrorism Day (21 May death); (f) Vajpayee Good Governance Day (25 Dec birth).

questions.stem: CONSTITUTION DAY of INDIA (Samvidhan Diwas) is celebrated on:

options.option_text: 26 NOVEMBER — Constitution was ADOPTED by CA on 26 Nov 1949 (came into force 26 Jan 1950); declared Constitution Day from 2015 (Ambedkar 125th birth anniv year)

questions.explanation: CONSTITUTION DAY (Samvidhan Diwas / Rashtriya Samvidhan Divas) — 26 NOVEMBER annually. Commemorates the DATE on which the CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY ADOPTED the CONSTITUTION OF INDIA — 26 NOVEMBER 1949 (came into force ~2 months later on 26 JANUARY 1950, REPUBLIC DAY). OFFICIALLY DECLARED by Govt of India on 19 November 2015 — during Dr. B.R. AMBEDKAR's 125TH BIRTH ANNIVERSARY year celebrations; earlier the day was observed as 'Law Day' since 1979 by the Supreme Court Bar Association. PM Modi announced it. AMBEDKAR (14 Apr 1891 – 6 Dec 1956) — 'Father of the Indian Constitution'; Chairman of the DRAFTING COMMITTEE (29 Aug 1947 – 24 Jan 1950); 'Architect of the Constitution'; tireless advocate for Dalits, women, + social justice. CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY: (1) Constituted 1946 under Cabinet Mission Plan; 389 members initially (later 299 after Partition). (2) First sitting 9 December 1946; temporary Chairman Dr. Sachchidanand SINHA (as senior-most). Permanent President = Dr. RAJENDRA PRASAD (elected 11 Dec 1946). (3) Vice-Presidents H.C. Mukherjee + V.T. Krishnamachari. (4) Drafted over 2 years 11 MONTHS 18 DAYS of deliberation. 11 sessions, 165 days of sitting. Adopted 26 Nov 1949. (5) Signed on 24 JAN 1950 by 284 members present (of 299); effect from 26 JAN 1950. 26 JAN chosen because CONGRESS had declared PURNA SWARAJ (Complete Independence) on 26 Jan 1930 (Lahore Session, Nehru presiding). HANDWRITTEN Constitution by calligrapher PREM BEHARI NARAIN RAIZADA; decorated by Nandalal BOSE + team; published in English + Hindi; bound in Dehradun. ORIGINAL handwritten copy kept in HELIUM-filled case in Parliament Library. Constitution is LONGEST written in world: 395 ARTICLES in 22 PARTS + 8 SCHEDULES originally; TODAY 470+ Articles + 25 PARTS + 12 SCHEDULES (after amendments). 105+ Constitutional Amendments so far. KEY SOURCES: (1) Government of India Act 1935 (~250 articles borrowed — federal scheme, governor, judiciary, public service commissions, administrative details, emergency provisions). (2) BRITISH — Parliamentary system, Rule of Law, single citizenship, Cabinet, legislative procedure. (3) USA — Fundamental Rights, Judicial review, written Constitution, Preamble, VP, impeachment, removal of judges. (4) IRELAND — DPSPs, nomination to RS, Presidential election method. (5) CANADA — Quasi-federal structure, residual powers with Centre, appointment of Governors, SC advisory jurisdiction. (6) AUSTRALIA — Concurrent list, Trade + Commerce, joint sitting. (7) FRANCE — Republic, ideals of liberty-equality-fraternity. (8) USSR — FDs (Part IV-A), planning, social-econ rights. (9) Weimar Germany — Emergency provisions. (10) JAPAN — procedure for SC. (11) S AFRICA — amendment procedure + RS election. Describe as 'borrowed' but SIGNIFICANTLY ADAPTED.

questions.stem: WORLD HEALTH DAY is observed on:

options.option_text: 7 APRIL — WHO anniversary (est. 7 Apr 1948); theme-based; 2024 'My Health, My Right'; 2025 'Healthy beginnings, hopeful futures'

questions.explanation: WORLD HEALTH DAY — 7 APRIL annually. Marks the FOUNDING DAY of WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION (WHO) — established 7 April 1948 as a specialised agency of UN, HQ Geneva. First World Health Day celebrated 1950. CURRENT WHO DG: Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus (Ethiopia, since 2017 — 2nd term from 2022). INDIA is founding member; Member of WHO's South-East Asia Region (SEARO, HQ New Delhi, 11 member states including India, Indonesia, Thailand, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Timor Leste, N Korea). WHO's FUNCTIONS: international health policy, disease surveillance, vaccine development, health system strengthening, emergencies (COVID-19 Public Health Emergency of International Concern Jan 2020-May 2023; Mpox 2022 + 2024; Ebola; pandemic treaty negotiations ongoing 2024). OTHER HEALTH-RELATED UN DAYS: (1) WORLD CANCER DAY — 4 FEB. (2) WORLD TB DAY — 24 MAR (discovery of M. tuberculosis by Robert Koch 1882). (3) WORLD AUTISM AWARENESS DAY — 2 APR. (4) WORLD MALARIA DAY — 25 APR. (5) WORLD NO TOBACCO DAY — 31 MAY. (6) WORLD BLOOD DONOR DAY — 14 JUN (Karl Landsteiner's birthday, ABO blood groups). (7) WORLD POPULATION DAY — 11 JUL. (8) WORLD BREASTFEEDING WEEK — 1-7 AUG. (9) ORS (Oral Rehydration Salts) DAY — 29 JUL. (10) WORLD MENTAL HEALTH DAY — 10 OCT. (11) WORLD SIGHT DAY — 2nd Thursday of Oct. (12) WORLD POLIO DAY — 24 OCT (Jonas Salk's birthday). (13) WORLD DIABETES DAY — 14 NOV (Banting's birthday; insulin). (14) WORLD AIDS DAY — 1 DEC. (15) UNIVERSAL HEALTH COVERAGE DAY — 12 DEC. INDIAN HEALTH DAYS: (a) NATIONAL DOCTORS' DAY — 1 JUL (B.C. Roy b./d.). (b) NATIONAL EPILEPSY DAY — 17 NOV. (c) NATIONAL DEWORMING DAY — 10 FEB + 10 AUG biannual. (d) NATIONAL TB ELIMINATION DAY — 24 MAR. (e) NATIONAL PHARMACIST DAY — 25 SEP. (f) ANTI-LEPROSY DAY / MARTYRS DAY — 30 JAN. (g) NATIONAL VACCINATION DAY — 16 MAR (India's 1st polio drop 1995). INDIA's MAJOR HEALTH MISSIONS: AYUSHMAN BHARAT (launched 23 Sep 2018, Jharkhand) = world's largest govt-funded health insurance covering ₹5 lakh/family/year for secondary + tertiary care; ~55 crore beneficiaries; PM-JAY + Health + Wellness Centres (HWCs). MISSION INDRADHANUSH (immunisation), MISSION POSHAN (nutrition), PM JAN AUSHADHI (generic medicines), Eat Right India, Fit India Movement, Digital Health Mission (ABDM — Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, 2021 — 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) ID). JAL JEEVAN MISSION (2019) — piped water to all rural households. SWACHH BHARAT (2014). NATIONAL RURAL HEALTH MISSION (2005) + NUHM (Urban). NHA + NHFS surveys. PM MATRU VANDANA YOJANA (maternity ₹5000 for 1st child).

questions.stem: HUMAN RIGHTS DAY is observed on:

options.option_text: 10 DECEMBER — anniversary of UDHR adoption 1948 by UN GA; India's National Human Rights Day also 10 Dec

questions.explanation: HUMAN RIGHTS DAY — 10 DECEMBER annually. Commemorates the adoption of the UNIVERSAL DECLARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS (UDHR) by the UN General Assembly on 10 DECEMBER 1948 at Palais de Chaillot, Paris. UDHR: 30 articles; drafted by UN Commission on Human Rights (chaired by ELEANOR ROOSEVELT, USA; members incl. Hansa Jivraj Mehta, India — first woman delegate to UN, contributed to replacing 'All men are born free' with 'All human beings are born free'); P.C. Chang (China), Charles Malik (Lebanon), John Humphrey (Canada), René Cassin (France; Nobel Peace 1968). 48 nations voted YES, 8 abstained (USSR, Poland, Czech, Ukraine, Byelorussia, Yugoslavia, Saudi Arabia, S Africa), 0 no. INDIA VOTED YES + played active role. UDHR is a FOUNDATIONAL document; NOT legally binding itself but inspired: (1) ICCPR (International Covenant on Civil + Political Rights, 1966) + (2) ICESCR (International Covenant on Economic, Social + Cultural Rights, 1966) — together with UDHR these form the INTERNATIONAL BILL OF HUMAN RIGHTS. (3) CEDAW (Women, 1979). (4) CAT (Torture, 1984). (5) CRC (Child, 1989). (6) CRPD (Persons with Disabilities, 2006). INDIA has ratified ICCPR + ICESCR + CRC + CAT (signed but not ratified) + CEDAW + CRPD. INDIAN CONSTITUTION FR (Part III) closely mirror UDHR. NATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION (NHRC) India — established 12 OCT 1993 under PROTECTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS ACT 1993. STATUTORY autonomous body. HQ New Delhi. Chairperson = retired CJI or SC judge (currently Justice V. Ramasubramanian, 2024-). FUNCTIONS: (1) Inquire into complaints of HR violations by public servants. (2) Intervene in court proceedings. (3) Visit detention facilities to study conditions. (4) Review effectiveness of HR safeguards. (5) Study international treaties + recommend to Govt. (6) Spread HR awareness. LIMITATIONS: (1) RECOMMENDATORY — cannot pass binding orders; (2) 1-year limit on complaint filing; (3) not apply to private sector violations. STATE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSIONS (SHRCs) — parallel in states. OTHER HR-RELATED DAYS: (1) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF THE VICTIMS OF ENFORCED DISAPPEARANCES — 30 AUG. (2) INTERNATIONAL DAY TO END IMPUNITY for CRIMES AGAINST JOURNALISTS — 2 NOV. (3) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR ABOLITION OF SLAVERY — 2 DEC. (4) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR ELIMINATION OF RACIAL DISCRIMINATION — 21 MAR. (5) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF INDIGENOUS PEOPLES — 9 AUG. (6) INTERNATIONAL DAY FOR TOLERANCE — 16 NOV. (7) INTERNATIONAL DAY OF PEACE — 21 SEP. INDIA's major HR landmark cases: Maneka Gandhi v. UOI (1978) — Art 21 expanded; Hussainara Khatoon (1979) — speedy trial; Vishakha v. Rajasthan (1997) — sexual harassment at workplace; D.K. Basu (1996) — arrest guidelines; Navtej Johar (2018) — decriminalised 377; Puttaswamy (2017) — privacy as FR; Joseph Shine (2018) — struck 497 adultery.

questions.stem: REPUBLIC DAY of INDIA (26 January) commemorates:

options.option_text: ENACTMENT of the CONSTITUTION (26 Jan 1950, replacing Govt of India Act 1935); date chosen in honour of 1930 PURNA SWARAJ declaration

questions.explanation: REPUBLIC DAY of INDIA — 26 JANUARY annually; marks the DATE on which the CONSTITUTION of INDIA came INTO FORCE (26 Jan 1950), replacing the colonial Government of India Act 1935, transitioning India from a BRITISH DOMINION into a SOVEREIGN, DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC. WHY 26 JAN specifically: (1) INC (Indian National Congress) had declared PURNA SWARAJ ('Complete Independence') on 26 JAN 1930 at its LAHORE SESSION (Dec 1929) presided by JAWAHARLAL NEHRU. After that, every 26 Jan was celebrated as INDEPENDENCE DAY (1930-1947). So when Constitution was ready (adopted 26 Nov 1949, signed 24 Jan 1950), it was made effective on 26 JAN 1950 to honour this historical symbolism. FIRST REPUBLIC DAY celebrations: Dr. RAJENDRA PRASAD became India's FIRST PRESIDENT on 26 Jan 1950 (sworn in at Durbar Hall, Rashtrapati Bhavan); Parliament + govt now owed allegiance to Constitution not British Crown. PRESIDENT began ceremonial governance; PM Nehru (already in office since 15 Aug 1947) continued. TRADITIONS of REPUBLIC DAY: (1) PRESIDENT hoists flag at Kartavya Path (earlier Rajpath till 2022). (2) CHIEF GUEST = foreign head of state/govt (symbolising India's global relations). Past Chief Guests: Indonesia's Sukarno (1950 — FIRST), French President Emmanuel Macron (2024 — 6th French CG), Brazil's Lula (2020), UAE Crown Prince (2017, also at ASEAN 2018), Obama (2015 — first US Chief Guest), Nawaz Sharif (2004 — only Pakistani), Putin (2007), etc. (3) 21-gun salute. (4) NATIONAL AWARDS presented — PADMA BHUSHAN / SHRI / VIBHUSHAN (2nd, 3rd, 4th highest civilian awards; BHARAT RATNA is highest — conferred at discretion anytime). (5) Presentation of GALLANTRY AWARDS — Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, Ashok Chakra. (6) PARADE on Kartavya Path — (a) ARMED FORCES columns (Army, Navy, AF, Coast Guard, CAPFs, NCC, Scouts + Guides); (b) military HARDWARE DISPLAY (tanks, artillery, missiles like BrahMos, Nag, Agni, Rafale flypast); (c) STATE TABLEAUX showcasing regional culture; (d) SCHOOL CHILDREN + folk dancers; (e) CAVALRY HORSES, CAMELS (BSF); (f) concluded by AF FLY-PAST (fighter jet formations, Sukhois, Rafales, LCA Tejas). (7) BEATING RETREAT — 29 Jan; Raisina Hills; Army/Navy/AF bands play ceremonial pieces; ends with 'ABIDE WITH ME' (dropped 2022 — controversial; replaced by 'Ae Mere Watan Ke Logon', 'Saare Jahan Se Achcha'). Formally concludes RDay celebrations. (8) PADMA AWARDS announced on 25 Jan, given later in March-April by President at Rashtrapati Bhavan. 26 JAN is also NATIONAL VOTERS' DAY? — NO, that's 25 JAN (ECI foundation 25 Jan 1950). 26 Jan is CELEBRATED WORLDWIDE by Indian embassies as Republic Day. INDEPENDENCE DAY = 15 AUGUST (Independence from Britain 1947). MAHATMA GANDHI's DEATH also happened 4 days after the first Republic Day (30 Jan 1948 by Nathuram Godse).
